items.text: Introduced a resolution, adopted by one vote, calling on the government to end a bilateral agreement that gives nationals of one country their own rules for residence, work, and family reunification. The resolution does not bind the government.
Introduced a bill making unlawful presence in the country a criminal offence again; amendments stripped it and the party withdrew it.
